**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on Bluefly. § 14.16 (Freedom of Action) is mutual and preserves each party's freedom to enter similar agreements. The only prohibition directed at us is § 14.11 (No Resale), which limits redistribution of IBM's Services rather than our own business activities, and § 13.2 concerns acceptable use of the Services. This satisfies the preferred position (no restriction on Customer).
